caption: The drawing depicts a central group of ten human figures, with the majority of figures clustered on the right side. The central figure, shown with a crown of thorns and mostly unclothed except for a loincloth, is surrounded by soldiers wearing red and blue uniforms and helmets. These soldiers appear to be removing the central figure’s clothing. One figure is holding a large cross behind the central figure. Another figure in the background wears a blue garment and a white head covering, while others have red garments or robes with patterned borders. To the left side of the drawing, separated from the group of figures by a mostly vertical dividing line, is a depiction of a landscape with a green hill, a winding path, a few sparse trees, and a couple of small brown animals. A large, dark, triangular formation is present in the foreground of the landscape. The sky in both sections of the composition is colored a dull gray. The overall palette of the drawing is muted, with dominant colors being red, blue, brown, green, and gray. There is visible text above the drawing that reads, "10 Jesus is Stripped of His Garments," and a signature "Geoffrey Holt" at the bottom right.
title: Station of the Cross No. 10: "Jesus is Stripped of His Garments"
